Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

beFAIR 0.3.0

Documentation

  • Updated and expanded vignettes.
  • Fixed pkgdown configuration so the online documentation site builds and renders correctly.

beFAIR 0.2.3

Bug fixes

  • The startProject() sandbox now works correctly with SQLite backends.
  • databaseUpdate() no longer exits automatically on connection failure; database and connection info is gathered without forcing an early return.

Internal

  • Removed leftover internal references to the old package name.

beFAIR 0.2.0

First public release.

Features

  • Project scaffolding: startProject(), addStudy(), addExperiment() and addAnalysis() create a structured FAIRground directory layout that links clinical studies, laboratory experiments and downstream analyses.
  • Codebook-driven schemas: data tables are defined in YAML codebooks (codebookRead(), codebookToTable(), codebookToEntries(), codebookToSummary()), and beFAIR creates and maintains the matching SQL tables.
  • Database management: databaseInitialize(), the databasePrepare*() family and databaseUpdate() build and refresh the FAIRground database, including project overviews (databaseUpdateOverview()) and linked publications (databaseUpdatePublications()). databaseExport() exports its contents.
  • Reproducible ETL: draftScript() generates ETL script templates from codebooks (codebookToDraft()), and sourceScript() runs and tracks them. plotDependencies() visualises dependencies between scripts and tables.
  • Validation: validateDatabook(), validateSourceId() and validateCytofExperiment() check data against codebook rules before loading, using pointblank.
  • Harmonisation helpers: harmonizeDate(), harmonizeGates() and getRelativeTimepoint() align dates, cytometry gates and time points across studies. Participants get stable pseudonymised identifiers derived with SHA-256.
  • Data access: FAIRgroundConnect(), collectTable(), collectTablesById(), searchId(), tableSummary() and tableVariableByStudy() query and join harmonised tables. FAIRgroundOverview() and viewCodebookMap() summarise what is in the database.

Documentation

  • Vignettes covering getting started, starting a project, adding studies, experiments and analyses, codebook configuration and reference, exploring and joining data tables, database smoke tests and developer internals.
  • pkgdown website.

Licensing and citation

  • Released under the Apache License 2.0.
  • Added CITATION.cff for software citation and Zenodo archiving.
